definitions.explanation: An alternative reading of 文字. Used in certain compounds and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {象形文字|しょうけいもんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：03561_hatten⟧。
examples.notes: [Note: 象形文字 (pictograph) uses the もんじ reading]

examples.japanese: {楔形文字|くさびがたもんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧メソポタミア⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Cuneiform was used in ancient Mesopotamia.
examples.notes: [Note: 楔形文字 (cuneiform) uses the もんじ reading]

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{文字|もんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。

notes:
READING: 文字 has two readings:
- もじ - common everyday reading
- もんじ - used in certain compounds, especially for historical/academic writing systems

COMPOUNDS WITH もんじ:
- {象形文字|しょうけいもんじ} (pictograph)
- {楔形文字|くさびがたもんじ} (cuneiform)
- {表音文字|ひょうおんもんじ} (phonetic character)
- {表意文字|ひょういもんじ} (ideograph)
- {梵字|ぼんじ} (Sanskrit characters)

NOTE: In general usage, もじ is the standard reading. もんじ is primarily found in academic terms for writing systems.

SIMILAR: ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧ (letter/character - common reading)
